scientific_integrity: Originality is proposed, not independently confirmed; all-parameter proof supplied separately from bounded checks.
scientific_limitations: Proves the finite top-extended Boolean family only; uses established finite Esakia duality. Exhaustive evidence only for small parameters. An earlier unindexed special-family calculation remains a possible originality antecedent.
title: Homomorphism rigidity and Bell-graded subalgebras of top-extended Boolean Heyting algebras
